verifiedSurfaceSummary: Verified on Wednesday, August 5, 2026 that https://talentsprint.com/careers/ remains the live first-party TalentSprint careers page and exposes View Job Openings to the public TalentSprint Darwinbox handoff at https://talentsprint.darwinbox.in/ms/candidate/careers. The public Darwinbox listing API POST at /ms/candidateapi/job/alljobs?companyId=main returned HTTP 500 in both the August 1 dry run and the August 5 browser-session probe, so this provider is a fail-closed sentinel that returns zero jobs while continuing to validate the first-party page and handoff.
